description: This file defines the EmailTask class, a workflow activity for sending emails within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It includes properties for email fields, handles email message creation, and executes email sending asynchronously.

classes.name: EmailTask
classes.description: A workflow activity class for composing and sending emails, supporting various email fields and body formats, integrated with OrchardCore workflows.

methods.name: DisplayText
methods.description: Returns the display name for the activity, 'Email Task'.

methods.name: Category
methods.description: Returns the category of the activity, 'Messaging'.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Performs the email sending operation asynchronously, evaluating properties, constructing the email message, and invoking the email service.
